node.title: Perl images for GitLab CI
node.author: kcott
node.doctext:
G'day All,

I have been tasked with investigating using GitLab CI/CD for our $work Perl modules. I am trying to locate documentation, or other information, on image: perl:5.???.

I started my search from "[https://perlmaven.com/gitlab-ci-module-build|GitLab CI Pipeline for Perl DBD::Mock using Module::Build]" (by [id://415035|Gábor Szabó]). Then, via a few links, I found "[https://gitlab.com/scrapheap/DBD-Mock/-/blob/master/.gitlab-ci.yml|DBD::Mock: .gitlab-ci.yml]". This shows image: perl:5.X-threaded (where X is all even values from 8 to 30) and an image: perl:latest.

From "[https://www.akeyes.co.uk/blog/gitlab_perl_ci_and_cd_pipeline|Gitlab Perl CI and CD Pipeline]", again via a few links, I found "[https://registry.hub.docker.com/_/perl/|Perl - Official Image|Docker Hub]". This page has an "Image Variants" section which explains the extension tags (e.g. -threaded) which was useful. However, it only lists Perl versions 5.30, 5.32 & 5.34 (and some without specific versions, e.g. latest).

At $work, we code to a minimum 5.16 version. I'd probably want image: perl:5.X (X=16..34) and image: perl:latest. It seems that there are only a limited number of official images. I don't want to just write image: perl:5.16, cross my fingers, and hope for the best (cargo-cult fashion). I would like to find out more: what's valid; do I need to download them; do I need to create them myself. So, any information on that would be greatly appreciated.

I have also looked in "[https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/ci/|GitLab CI/CD]" and "[id://3989|Super Search]". I didn't find anything useful; however, it's not impossible that I overlooked something in these.

— Ken
